**0906 Ekko-kardiografi** is a specific procedure code used within the Danish healthcare system to identify echocardiographic examinations. It is one of several registered codes in the [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] (National Health Service Register) utilized for tracking and measuring the quality of care for patients with atrial fibrillation [^src1]. As part of the broader clinical quality indicators established by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), this code helps standardize data collection for diagnosing and following up on cardiovascular conditions across Danish regions.

In the context of atrial fibrillation quality measurement, [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] (echocardiography) is a critical diagnostic procedure. The procedure is mapped to multiple specific codes depending on the exact type of examination performed. Alongside 0906, the Sygesikringsregisteret includes several other echocardiography codes such as [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]], [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]], [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]], [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]] [^src1]. 

The code 0906 is explicitly recorded in national quality reports, such as the 2023 and 2024 annual reports for the Atrial Fibrillation Database in Denmark, where it is listed in the technical guidelines for calculating clinical quality indicators [^src1] [^src2]. These indicators ensure that patients receive evidence-based diagnostic evaluations, supporting RKKP's role as the national coordinating unit for clinical quality development.
